events.title: PULL UP & PLAY: Leftovers Edition
events.blurb: Gel blasters for teens and adults, 1:30–2:30 PM, then a family-friendly Nerf battle, 2:30–3:30 PM. Wear sneakers, bring water, and follow ADC safety rules. Eye protection is required for gel blasters.

copy.heroSub: Hosted Nerf team days for Atlanta companies — plus birthdays and city pop-ups across Decatur & Atlanta. We bring the gear, set up anywhere, and run the whole event — you just bring the crowd.
